unit.title: Expressions, Equality, and Linear Equations
unit.act: Act II - Preserving truth while changing form
unit.role: Build the central equivalence engine of elementary algebra.
unit.governingQuestion: How can an equation change form without changing its solutions?
unit.storyArc: Students first test solutions, then use inverse operations and simplification to construct equivalent equations. The unit ends with strategy selection and one-variable modeling.
outcomes: Define a solution and solution set.
Construct equivalent linear equations using legal operations.
Solve equations containing parentheses, fractions, decimals, and variables on both sides.
unit.investigation: Reconstruct an original quantity after a sequence of fees, discounts, or changes.
unit.mastery: Mixed equations without method labels; students must show an equivalence-preserving chain and verify the result.
